questions: Did these abnormal postures or movements begin suddenly?
Have they progressively worsened over time?
Are the movements present every day?
Do they disappear completely when you are asleep?
Can you temporarily suppress or voluntarily stop them?
Do they become worse when you are stressed, anxious, tired, or watched?
Do they improve when you are distracted or performing another task?
Do you experience an urge or uncomfortable sensation before the movements?
Have you ever lost awareness, blacked out, or been confused during an episode?
Have you had seizures?
Did you have delayed motor, speech, or intellectual development as a child?
Did you have difficulty walking or abnormal muscle stiffness during childhood?
Have you had any recent fever, brain infection, head injury, or poisoning?
Have you taken medicines for nausea, psychiatric illness, seizures, or abnormal movements?
Has anyone in your family had similar movements, tremor, seizures, or an unexplained neurological illness?
Have you had difficulty speaking, swallowing, or controlling your saliva?
Have you had tremor, slowness, stiffness, poor balance, or difficulty walking?
Have you had yellowing of the eyes or skin, abdominal swelling, or other liver problems?
Have you noticed a brown or greenish ring around the colored part of either eye?
Have you had unexplained weight loss, loss of appetite, or persistent vomiting?
Have you had recent changes in behavior, mood, school performance, or thinking?
Do you have pain or loss of sensation in your arms or legs?
Have these symptoms improved substantially after any medication?
